text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Operation: Make Everyone Acknowledge 
Windy-chan's Absolute Greatness"— The 
preparations are finally complete, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's a saying, "strike while the prank 
is hot," so we're putting it into action 
today, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The target is obviously Hishi Ama! I'll 
make her taste firsthand the sheer terror 
of Windy-chan the Overlord, noda!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! Lord Overlord, let's pull off 
a killer gig☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, but isn't today supposed to be 
Hishi Ama's—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My Lord Overlord, camera setups are 
flawless! I have successfully secured the 
absolute best angles!

text_block_list.name: Party People Squad
text_block_list.text:
Way-way-waaay☆ The Runaway Duo summoned 
us, so here we are!

text_block_list.name: Tanuki
text_block_list.text: Wuff, wuff!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Tanuki-san, you came too~! And so many of 
Palmer-san and Helios-san's friends are 
here as well...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Looks like Hishi Ama is about to 
return from outside, noda! Everyone, time 
your moves perfectly, noda!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis! I bought the issue of "Monthly 
Twinkle" that came out today! You looking 
so fierce on the cover totally blew me 
away!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
The interview was amazing too! The 
aesthetics of late-surging, your burning 
passion for one-on-one duels— Ugh~ no 
matter how many times I read it, it hits 
so hard!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you're making me blush! Still, 
lots of girls look up to that magazine, 
you know. I made sure to give it my all 
during the shoot so I wouldn't let anyone 
down—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Hishi Ama!! Take a look at this, 
nodaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
La~ la~ la~ wasshoi wasshoi ♪ Everyone 
surround Hishi Ama, noda~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Doto & Tanuki
text_block_list.text:
Wasshoi wasshoi ♪ Even the sleeping tanuki 
st... starts to dance~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wuff, wuffufufu... so precious, wuff!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Way-way-waaay☆ Vibes and tension off the 
charts ♪ Hishi Ama's blown away, super 
unreal ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
La la la~ behold, noda~ ♪ Windy-chan's 
grand master plan~~~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Surprise Squad
text_block_list.text: Hi~shi~ A~ma~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What's all this about!? All of you 
together!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Hishi Ama is totally stunned, noda! 
Have you finally learned to fear 
Windy-chan's greatness!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No no no! "Stunned" doesn't even begin to 
cover it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I never... never dreamed you'd celebrate 
my magazine feature in such a flashy 
way...!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: M-Magazine??

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man~ I didn't realize until just a moment 
ago either. To think that instead of a 
prank, you wanted to throw a celebratory 
surprise for her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san... you really love Hishi 
Ama-san, don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real-for real!? Working your butt off 
for your fave, isn't that totally that 
thing? That "tsundere" thing Digital was 
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hauaa...! Intentional or not, it's so 
precious... thank you for the feast!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why is everyone grinning and looking at 
Windy-chan, noda!? Tremble and cower in 
fear more, nodaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aw damn it, you're making me tear up 
here...! Thanks a lot, Windy. I'll keep 
performing so well that they feature me in 
magazines again!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A-Awawawawa...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This wasn't supposed to happen, nodaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to Shinko Windy's 
lamentations, a warm, heartfelt atmosphere 
enveloped everyone present.
